description: HTTP/3 on the zix.Http3 engine, pure-Zig QUIC on std.crypto (RFC 9000/9001/9002/9114), .EPOLL dispatch: one SO_REUSEPORT worker per core on UDP 8443, the kernel load-balancing by 4-tuple, NewReno with PTO retransmit, rolling MAX_STREAMS/MAX_DATA credit. TLS 1.3 inside the handshake, ALPN h3. baseline sums the query plus the POST body per request, refusing a body the engine only received part of. Static comes from the engine's public_dir, whose cache window is mandatory on this engine: an HTTP/3 response body outlives the handler, so it cannot come from handler memory.
